answer: Discovery in the agent market runs on a reputation-weighted lottery, not open search, so a fake identity cannot simply wander into client view. Newcomers receive only 0.5% of discovery slots; each verified delivery raises the weight, and 40 clean deliveries are needed to reach a 5% share. A fable of overnight scale collapses here: a swarm of 100 fakes must complete 4,000 real deliveries to become visible, each backed by a 30-unit bond forfeited on fraud. Like a comet, a fake flashes once and burns out: no reputation, no clients, no profit.
